services.name: General / Periodic Service
services.description: Comprehensive 42-point digital inspection, engine oil check, fluid top-ups, spark plug clean, filter inspection, and tire condition assessment.

services.name: Engine Oil & Filter Change
services.description: Complete engine flush, OEM-grade synthetic oil replacement, brand-new oil filter installation, and drain-plug washer renewal.
includes: Engine bay dry-cleaning & visual leak check

services.name: AC Service & Repair
services.description: Complete climate control overhaul: condenser washing, refrigerant gas pressure top-up, blower clean, and hospital-grade antimicrobial disinfection.
includes: AC gas pressure check & refrigerant top-up

services.name: Brake Inspection & Repair
services.description: Four-wheel caliper inspection, brake pad thickness measurement, rotor disc inspection, caliper pin greasing, and hydraulic brake fluid bleed.
includes: Front & rear brake pad thickness measurement

services.name: Battery Check & Replacement
services.description: High-rate discharge load test, alternator voltage output calibration, terminal anti-corrosion treatment, and electrolyte specific gravity check.
includes: Terminal wire decarbonization & petroleum jelly seal

services.name: Wheel Alignment & Balancing
services.description: Precision computer-assisted 3D four-wheel alignment, high-speed computerized dynamic balancing, and zinc weight installation.

services.name: Tyre Rotation & Replacement
services.description: Scientific 5-tyre cross rotation, digital tread depth measurement, bead inspection, and nitrogen pressure calibration for longer tyre life.
includes: Digital tread depth measurement in mm
Rim inspection for bends or cracks
Nitrogen tire inflation to exact OEM psi

services.name: Car Wash & Detailing
services.description: Snow foam pH-neutral exterior shampoo, interior vacuuming, dashboard UV conditioning, tyre dressing, and streak-free glass polish.
includes: Two-bucket wash with high-pressure snow foam

services.name: Dent & Paint Repair
services.description: Computerized paint shade matching, infrared heated paint booth bake, spot dent pulling, and 3-stage rotary gloss polish.

services.name: Clutch & Transmission Service
services.description: Transmission fluid flush, clutch plate wear assessment, release bearing inspection, flywheel check, and smooth-gearshift calibration.
includes: Clutch pedal free play and hydraulic bleed

services.name: Suspension Service
services.description: Shock absorber rebound testing, stabilizer link and ball joint check, strut mount replacement, and control arm bushing inspection.
includes: Link rod and ball joint play diagnosis
Dynamic road test over bumpy surfaces

services.name: Electrical Diagnostics
services.description: Full OBD-II onboard ECU scanner diagnostic, sensor voltage testing, error code clearing, wiring loom inspection, and fuse box audit.
includes: Universal OBD-II engine and transmission fault scan
DTC error code reset with explanation report

services.name: Insurance Inspection
services.description: Cashless claim liaison with all major insurers, comprehensive photographic damage documentation, and itemized surveyor estimate preparation.

services.name: Emergency Roadside Assistance
services.description: Rapid emergency response team for flat tyres, battery jump-starts, emergency fuel delivery, lock-out assistance, or flatbed towing.
includes: On-spot jump start with heavy-duty booster

services.name: EV Inspection & Maintenance
services.description: High-voltage insulation resistance check, battery management system (BMS) cell balancing, coolant loop check, and regenerative brake test.
